verdict.reason: Still no trade at 6:35am PT. EUR/USD is 1.0970, on the top of the 1.0966–1.0970 zone you marked. With the EMA 50 now on the chart, the EMAs have just crossed up and RSI is 53, but there's still no candle trigger on the retest. The next resistance at about 1.0977 only gives about 1:1. New entries on all 7 majors are blocked until the FOMC minutes at 11:00am PT.

watchlist.missing: Long break of the 1.0966–1.0970 zone. After the spike low at about 1.0954, strong green M5 candles closed above the zone (close beyond, displacement), followed through to about 1.0976, and took out the prior M5 swing high (structure). Price came back into the zone and is holding at 1.0970 (retest). The 6:35am chart shows the EMA 20 (about 1.0968) just crossing above the flat EMA 50, with price above both and RSI at 53. That's a borderline pass, read on M5 not M15. That makes it 5/6 at best, but there's no bullish engulfing or pin bar at the retest, only small two-sided candles, so it stays C. Pricing it doesn't work either: entry about 1.0970 with the SL at about 1.0962 (2–3 pips under the retest swing) and TP at about 1.0977 resistance is roughly 1:1, well under 1:2. The zone has also been crossed both ways several times since last night. Blocked by the FOMC minutes at 11:00am PT.

newsBlocks: Released: UK CPI (Oct) at 11:00pm PT last night. GBP/USD isn't blocked by it any more, but every setup still has to pass the rules.
11:00am PT FOMC minutes: no new entries on any USD pair (all 7 majors) before the release. After it, a setup can requalify only if the break-and-retest still holds.
watchFor: EUR/USD (after 11:00am PT): a displacement body close above 1.0977 resistance, then a retest from above with a bullish engulfing or pin bar, the EMA 20 above the EMA 50 and RSI under 70. Please mark the next resistance above 1.0977 so there's a target to check for 1:2.

EUR/USD (after 11:00am PT): a displacement close below 1.0966, then a retest from underneath with a bearish engulfing or pin bar. TP 1.0954 needs an SL of about 4 pips to make 1:2, so only with a very tight retest swing.
Please mark the next H1/M15 resistance above 1.0977. Without a higher target, a long from this zone can't reach 1:2.
